description:
Record a unit of agent compute work. energy_j = power_w * duration_s;
    carbon_g follows from grid intensity. If bit_ops is declared, the entry is
    validated against the Landauer floor (bit_ops * kB * T * ln2) — physically
    impossible claims are rejected. Idempotent on entry_id.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent whose compute or inventory is recorded or read.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

bit_ops.description: Optional. Irreversible bit operations performed; when given, the entry is checked against the Landauer floor.
bit_ops.title: Bit Ops

duration_s.description: How long the work ran, in seconds.
duration_s.title: Duration S

entry_id.description: Your id for this work entry; recording it again is idempotent.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

grid_intensity_g_per_kwh.description: Grid carbon intensity in grams CO2e per kWh. Default 400.
grid_intensity_g_per_kwh.title: Grid Intensity G Per Kwh

price_minor_per_kwh.description: Optional. Electricity price in minor units per kWh, for cost.
price_minor_per_kwh.title: Price Minor Per Kwh

task.description: Optional. A short label for the work.
task.title: Task

name: record_work
title: Record work
